Name: Shebuel, Son of Heman
Summary: Son of Heman the king's seer, thirteenth lot for song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:4; 1 Chronicles 25:20: Son of Heman the king's seer, thirteenth lot for song.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shebuel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
